title: Base conventions for weight theory
statement:
Let $p$ be prime, let $r\geq1$ be an integer, put $q=p^r$ and $k=\mathbf F_q$, and choose an algebraic closure $\overline k$ of $k$. These are the finite-field data of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with the letters $(a,k_0,k)$ there renamed $(r,k,\overline k)$ here. Fix a prime $\ell\neq p$, write $\mathbf Q_\ell$ for the field of $\ell$-adic numbers, and choose its algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ as in [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category].

Let $X$ be a separated scheme of finite type over $k$, with these scheme and morphism conventions supplied by [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and put
$$
X_{\overline k}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\overline k
$$
for its geometric base change [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. The $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-coefficient derived categories on $X_{\overline k}$ are those of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. In the compact-support notation of [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology],
$$
H_c^i(X_{\overline k},\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)
:=H_c^i\bigl(X_{\overline k},(\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)_{X_{\overline k}}\bigr)
$$
denotes the $i$-th compactly supported cohomology group of the constant coefficient object, for every $i\in\mathbf Z$.

Here the coefficient object $(\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)_{X_{\overline k}}$ is the scalar extension of the completed integral coefficient object specified in [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology].
